statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope
The patient has transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
